parts.problem_md:
120 students are asked about their favourite country to visit in Europe, out of France, Spain, Portugal, Italy, and Croatia.

![Bar chart of country frequencies: France 45, Spain 25, Portugal 30, Italy 0, Croatia 5; France has highest frequency, Italy has none.](assets/003-bar-chart-of-country-frequencies-france-45-spain.png)

Complete the bar chart above.
parts.solution_md:
> *Add up all the known bars in the cart*

$41+19+25+13=98$

> *Subtract this from the total number of students to get the missing country*

$120-98=22$

**[M1]**

![Bar chart showing frequency of five countries: France (highest at 45), Portugal (30), Italy (25), Spain (20), Croatia (lowest at 10).](assets/004-bar-chart-showing-frequency-of-five-countries-fr.png)

**[A1]**

> *Add 2 to both sides*

bold italic y bold greater than bold 7

parts.solution_md:
> *Recall that*
* *$3^{2}=9$* and *`open parentheses negative 3 close parentheses squared equals 9`

> *Consider the first option*
* *$2\frac{7}{8}$* is less than 3, and not negative, so when squared, will not be larger than 9*

> *Consider the second option *
*2.8 is less than 3, and not negative, so when squared, will not be larger than 9*

> *Consider the third option *
*3 squared is exactly 9, but the inequality is a >, not a ≥, so this is incorrect*

> *Consider the fourth option*

> * *$-\frac{7}{2}$* is equivalent to *$-3.5$*, and *`open parentheses negative 3.5 close parentheses squared`* will be larger than 9*

> *So option four is correct*

** The correct option is option four, **$-\frac{7}{2}$ **[1]**
